# Microsoft NuiSensorLib

Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/MixedRealityCompanionKit

Revision: `0e3e8f3cb44c6683f0a1b0a0f561074fa9e6f88c`

`NuiSensorLib.h`, `NuiSensorLib.lib`, `KinectRgbCommand.cpp`, and `NuiSensor.cpp` originate from `KinectIPD/NuiSensor/`. `KinectExposure.cs` originates from `KinectIPD/KinectIPD/`. `LICENSE.txt` is the upstream root `License.txt` (MIT, Microsoft 2016). The static import is x64. Only the header and library are build inputs; the sample source files are reference material.

The application uses a fresh C++ wrapper in `src/exposure.cpp`; no OBS plugin code is incorporated.
